item.text: I found the core mismatch: URL records are global and unscoped, and the render/insert paths call restoration without any message identity. The composer’s `composerID` is the available per-message assistant identity, so I’m threading it through those paths while retaining the account UID separately for image proxy generation. I’m also correcting the Markdown rule configuration and adding the requested list repair helper.

The main flow now passes `composerID` into content preparation and result rendering, while image proxying still uses the account UID. Scoped restoration removes unrecognized or cross-message URLs (retaining anchor text), and formatted links/images are carried as inline HTML through Markdown so their class/style survive. I’m checking call-site types and the existing assistant URL tests now.

item.text:
Implemented the assistant Markdown/HTML fixes. Message identity now flows through content preparation, editor insertion, and result rendering; URL restoration is scoped to that identity, and unrecognized links lose their URL while unrecognized images are removed.

Also preserved link and image class/style, enabled Markdown list conversion with configurable disabled rules, added `fixNestedLists`, and updated indentation cleanup to preserve nested list depth.

Validation: the existing assistant URL and composer content helper tests pass. Prettier and `git diff --check` pass. The mail workspace type check reports one unrelated OpenPGP type incompatibility in `packages/crypto/lib/worker/api.ts:579`.
